protocol: M4 Edge ANGLE Metal, production preview same generated JPEG fixture, separate fresh contexts with default Image or experimental Blob/ImageBitmap, 3 cycles of 20 native keyboard commands each. Explicit GC twice at matched endpoints; DOM.getDetachedDomNodes only at final endpoint to minimize inspector handle retention. Single run per path, shared browser/driver caches. Single-image pixel comparison uses 384x512 composited rasters, six synthetic PNG/JPEG/WebP cases, not general color/EXIF/ICC certification. UI and gesture regression uses actual mouse/keyboard, unrelated pointercancel synthetically injected, CDP touch emulation.
